title: Chat
description: A native chat transcript with grouped bubbles, photos and files, delivery and read receipts, typing, older history and a windowed mode for long conversations.

blocks.text: Chat shows a conversation as native message bubbles. PHP publishes the messages, oldest first; the native list keys them by ID, groups them, opens at the newest one, and reports reads, retries, message actions and file opens back to PHP. It doesn't send, store or sync anything itself: your screen owns the messages and decides how they reach a server.

blocks.text:
<?php

namespace App\NativeComponents;

use FirstlightUI\Media\MediaStorage;
use FirstlightUI\Media\MediaValue;
use FirstlightUI\NativeComponent;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class Conversation extends NativeComponent
{
    /** @var list<array<string, mixed>> */
    public array $messages = [];

    /** @var list<MediaValue> */
    public array $pending = [];

    public string $draft = '';

    public function send(): void
    {
        $this->messages[] = [
            'id' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'author' => (string) auth()->id(),
            'body' => trim($this->draft),
            'sent-at' => now()->toIso8601String(),
            'status' => 'sending',
            'actions' => ['delete'],
            'attachments' => array_map(fn (MediaValue $media, int $index) => [
                'id' => (string) $index,
                'kind' => str_starts_with($media->mime, 'image/') ? 'image' : 'file',
                'source' => $media,
            ], $this->pending, array_keys($this->pending)),
        ];
        $this->draft = '';
        $this->pending = [];
        // Send to your server here, then republish the same id as sent or failed.
    }

    public function addAttachment(string $tempPath): void
    {
        $this->pending[] = MediaStorage::commit($tempPath, 'mobile_public', 'chat');
    }

    public function removeAttachment(int $index): void
    {
        MediaStorage::delete($this->pending[$index] ?? null);
        array_splice($this->pending, $index, 1);
    }

    public function markReadUpTo(string $messageId): void {}

    public function resend(string $messageId): void {}

    public function messageAction(string $key, string $messageId): void {}

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('native.conversation');
    }
}

<native:column class="w-full flex-1">
    <firstlight:chat
        class="w-full flex-1"
        :messages="$messages"
        me="{{ auth()->id() }}"
        :actions="['delete' => ['label' => 'Delete', 'destructive' => true, 'icon' => 'delete']]"
        @read="markReadUpTo"
        @retry="resend"
        @action="messageAction"
        label="Chat with Sam"
    />

    <native:bottom-bar>
        <firstlight:chat-composer
            native:model.debounce.300ms="draft"
            :attachments="$pending"
            placeholder="Message"
            attach="photos,camera,files"
            @send="send"
            @attach="addAttachment"
            @removeAttachment="removeAttachment"
            label="Message to Sam"
        />
    </native:bottom-bar>
</native:column>

<firstlight:chat
    class="w-full flex-1"
    :messages="$window"
    me="{{ auth()->id() }}"
    :count="$count"
    :window-from="$from"
    :window-to="$to"
    @windowChange="setWindow"
    label="Chat with Sam"
/>

Each message reads as one element: "You" or the author's name, the body, "2 photos" or the file's name and size, the time, and for the newest outgoing message its status. Copy, each authored action, Try again and Open for each attachment are accessibility actions, so nothing needs a long press. When the reader is at the bottom, an arriving message is announced politely; the typing row is announced when it appears. Day separators are headings, and rows outside a window are hidden from assistive technology.

, a Material dropdown menu, the system viewer for files through a FileProvider, and a full-screen pager for photos.
